# Livane Renovation

Livane Renovation coordinates and executes residential and commercial renovation scopes across Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach. Services include interior renovation, tile and stone installation, doors and finish carpentry, material sourcing through specialist partners, and floor restoration.

## Canonical pages
- Home: https://www.livanerenovation.com/
- About: https://www.livanerenovation.com/about
- Projects: https://www.livanerenovation.com/projects
- References: https://www.livanerenovation.com/references
- Sourcing partners and material categories: https://www.livanerenovation.com/materials
- Knowledge base: https://www.livanerenovation.com/blog
- Contact: https://www.livanerenovation.com/quote

## Business relationships
- Completed work and selected project relationships are identified on the references page.
- Okan Tower is presented as a contract-phase project, not completed work.
- Eurasia Stone, NG Kütahya and Best Door are sourcing partners, not completed client projects.
- Material images on the materials page are illustrative and do not identify a specific partner SKU.
